operational_limitations.limitation: NO SHELL AND NO STRICT PARSE.
operational_limitations.detail: The session's tools were read, write, edit, glob and grep. No Bash or command-execution tool was available, so neither a strict yaml.safe_load with duplicate-key detection nor python3 tools/validate_ledger.py could be run against the files written. The brief required this to be stated plainly rather than claiming a parse that did not happen, and it is stated here.
operational_limitations.mitigation: Every free-text value is written as a folded block scalar with '>-', where YAML applies no quoting rules to the content; remaining plain scalars are short and single-quoted where they contain a colon, comma-in-flow or parentheses; no key is repeated at any nesting level; every block-sequence item begins with '- '; no tab characters were written.
operational_limitations.residual_risk: Real and unquantified. Manual measures are not a parse. Any defect the orchestrator's strict parser finds in these files is a defect of this task, not noise.

operational_limitations.detail: The one file written for a proposal later excluded from scope could not be removed and was neutralised in place instead. See artifact_must_be_deleted_before_commit.

operational_limitations.limitation: THIS WORKTREE CANNOT SEE UNMERGED BRANCHES.
operational_limitations.detail: Every conversion-status and supersession check this session could run resolved against one working tree. Five of the eight assigned proposals were already converted on branches not present here and were invisible to the query the brief specified. That was caught only because the dispatching Coordinator re-ran the audit across all git refs and sent a correction mid-task. The defect, the corrected query, and the residual limitation of even the corrected query are recorded in the conversion report under defect_in_the_brief_as_written.
operational_limitations.consequence_carried_into_the_records: Each of the three new contracts records this blindness in its own Stage 0 and requires the run to restate it, so no supersession statement in them reads as stronger than it is.

operational_limitations.limitation: ONE APPROVAL BLOCKER COULD NOT BE DISCHARGED.
operational_limitations.detail: H-ECDLP-4d21c2 and EXP-ECDLP-7dba4b, derived from IDEA-20260815-284aff, carry an OUTSTANDING distinctness check against H-ECDLP-6c52c0, the reported conversion of the sibling proposal IDEA-20260731-013. That record is not in this worktree and could not be read, so whether the new contract measures anything it does not is undetermined. It is not guessed at: it is written into the hypothesis's interpretation_limits, into the experiment's approval_gate as its single most important precondition, into Stage 0 as a run-time check, and into the required artifacts.

No search_knowledge, get_context, get_source or find_related call was made; the MCP retrieval tools were not present in this session's tool surface. Novelty verdicts were therefore carried from the parent proposals unchanged rather than re-screened, every external citation in the new records is marked provenance 'recalled' with verified_by null, and no entry claims a verification that did not occur. Absence of a retrieval result is not claimed as evidence of anything.

findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.finding: IDEA-20260808-2e14f7 carries a committed do_not_dispatch verdict, and a hypothesis for it is reported to exist on an unmerged branch.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.detail: ledger/corrections/CORR-20260808-f4d780.yaml gives that proposal the verdict DUPLICATE_AND_MECHANISM_REFUTED with 'do_not_dispatch: true' and the disposition that it must NOT be dispatched to /design-experiment, on the ground that its central mechanism -- d times the factor-base points per unit of window budget from a degree-d coordinate map -- is false by Burnside, and that the Coordinator re-derived the refutation independently at three primes. The dispatcher's all-refs audit reports H-ECDLP-30a2a1 as a conversion of that same proposal. This session cannot read H-ECDLP-30a2a1 and does not adjudicate it.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.recommended_action: Whoever holds that branch should check whether H-ECDLP-30a2a1 cites CORR-20260808-f4d780 and scopes itself around the refutation. An all-refs audit reading only hypotheses and experiments would not surface this, because the correction lives in ledger/corrections/.

findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.finding: The premise of IDEA-20260815-3c9919 is already partly false at the contract level.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.detail: experiments/EXP-RHO-60da4f/specification.yaml is an APPROVED contract in this worktree whose secondary metrics include a measured collision constant and the distinguished-point table size with peak RSS, at tier medium over 2^32 to 2^48. The proposal asserts that no record in this corpus measures rho's constant. What survives cleanly is the parallel arm: that contract states in its own optimistic-assumption list that parallelisation is MODELED as near-linear rather than measured. EXP-ECDLP-4320a7 makes this a Stage 0 terminator and concentrates its content on the measured speedup curve.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.recommended_action: Rank EXP-ECDLP-4320a7 with EXP-RHO-60da4f in view, and note that the ECDLP rho-census lane already holds a chain of six unapproved review_required contracts (EXP-ECDLP-51921d, a76937, 1c12d3, e8ef62, 2ebd6c, 5ec1c5) under RQ-ECDLP-165d4b.

findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.finding: Cross-goal duplication risk on the uncharged multi-target measurement.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.detail: experiments/EXP-MTGT-d4f8cd/specification.yaml, a draft under GOAL-ENDO-001 and RQ-MTGT-2cabee, already specifies total and per-target group operations per arm per M, peak store size in entries and bytes per arm, and a fitted exponent of M with confidence interval, at toy scale with a success criterion of 0.50 plus or minus 0.05 over M in 1 to 32. Its object is isogeny transport and the same-curve arm is its calibration, so it is not identical to EXP-ECDLP-7dba4b, but the uncharged arm would be bought twice if both were approved.
findings_raised_for_the_coordinator.recommended_action: A Coordinator decision spanning GOAL-ECDLP-001 and GOAL-ENDO-001 on which contract owns that measurement, before either is approved. Recorded as an approval-gate item on EXP-ECDLP-7dba4b.

brief_compliance.tier_honesty: All three converted contracts are labelled toy, and the label is EARNED rather than conservative: each constructs and solves prime-order subgroups at 16 to 28 bits, all at or below the 32-bit toy boundary. No contract in this batch instantiates nothing, so no tier null was assigned here.
brief_compliance.cost_model_measurement_pattern_applied: Applied to all three, each of which is a baseline measurement. Every contract carries a measured_vs_modeled block with both lists, an optimistic-assumption list where each entry states the DIRECTION of its bias, peak memory as a primary metric reported beside time with a completed_invalid rule for any table omitting it, and a time-memory tradeoff statement with an explicit interpolation range.
brief_compliance.conditionality_preserved: Each parent heuristic -- HEUR-RHO-BASE-1, HEUR-BSGS-1, HEUR-BATCH-1 -- is carried with its original id, its formal statement verbatim, and its rigorous-ingredient-plus-THE-GAP justification quoted in full. Where a stated condition was not decidable as written, an operationalisation is added in a separate field and flagged as a Coordinator addition; the original wording is never softened or replaced.
